name: Kyalami
summary: South Africa's Grand Prix home, high on the Highveld near Johannesburg.
character: About 1,520 metres above sea level, so engines lost power in the thin air. A long downhill main straight into Crowthorne corner made for fast racing on the original layout.

moments.title: Mansell starts 1992 with a win
moments.body: Nigel Mansell won from pole in the Williams FW14B at the 1992 opener, the first of nine wins on his way to the title.

history.body: First World Championship race at Kyalami.
Last race on the original layout.
Two races on a rebuilt, shorter-straight layout.

leftCalendar: F1 left after 1985 during the international boycott over apartheid. It came back for 1992 and 1993 on a rebuilt layout, then lost the race again.
